description: One verification record per claim. See RESEARCH-STANDARDS.md section 8. A claim is publishable ONLY when result is verified AND editorialApproval is recorded. Partially-verified, not-verified, contradicted, and unable-to-verify claims must never be published.

checkDate.description: Date the check was performed, YYYY-MM-DD.

checker.description: Who checked the claim. Must be independent of the researcher who wrote the record (standards section 9.2).

claimId.description: Id of the claim being checked, as used by the record it belongs to (passage, interpretation, milestone, or work entry).

claimText.description: Exactly what is claimed — the same words that would be published. Verifying a paraphrase does not verify the claim.

editorialApproval.description: Editorial approval, recorded separately from verification. Null until approved. Required for publishability.

note.description: Any conditions or override details. An editorial override without explicit approval must not be recorded as approval.

evidenceFound.description: Verbatim excerpt or precise locator supporting the result, or the literal words 'none found'.

id.description: Stable slug for this verification record, e.g. ver-gen-1-26-classification-001.

limitations.description: Remaining limitations and open questions. Honest gaps, not a formality.

result.description: Outcome of the check. Only verified is publishable, and only with editorial approval.

sourcesChecked.description: Every source actually checked. 'Checked' means the checker read the relevant part of that source. At least one source is required.

dateAccessed.description: Date the source was accessed, YYYY-MM-DD.

locator.description: Precise locator: book/chapter/section, page, or URL.
